Printed edition: Angiola Maria storia domestica di Giulio Carcano, aggiuntovi Il manoscritto del vicecurato, Ida Della Torre, episodio patrio, La Nunziata, racconto campagnuolo, Canzoni popolari e Armonie domestiche inedite, F. Le Monnier, 1852, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_Ratkg30FtIEC. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 85%, 60%, 63% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Giulio Carcano, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
